title: Android Developer
description: Build native, modern Android applications using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Flow, Room database, and clean architecture principles.

goal.objective: Architect robust, performant native Android mobile applications that deliver smooth 60fps experiences across the diverse global Android device ecosystem.

learn.summary: Master Kotlin language, Jetpack Compose UI, Android Lifecycle, StateFlow, Room local database, Retrofit networking, Hilt dependency injection, and Play Store publishing.

capstone_projects.title: Offline-First Fitness & Workout Companion
capstone_projects.description: Build an offline-first fitness tracker with animated exercise routines, SQLite synchronization, and background notification alarms.

capstone_projects.title: High-Performance Offline-First Navigation App
capstone_projects.description: Build an offline-first geospatial navigation client with unidirectional data flow (MVI), background telemetry syncing via WorkManager, and dynamic theming.

topics.name: Kotlin Language Fundamentals
topics.description: Master Kotlin syntax, variables, data types, control flow, functions (including higher-order functions and lambdas), classes, objects, data classes, inheritance, interfaces, collections, null safety, exception handling, and idiomatic Kotlin practices.

resources.title: Full 2025 Kotlin Crash Course For Beginners (Philipp Lackner)

topics.name: Asynchronous Programming with Coroutines
topics.description: Understand concurrency and asynchronous programming in Kotlin. Learn about suspend functions, CoroutineScope, CoroutineContext, Dispatchers, Flows, Channels, and structured concurrency for building responsive and efficient Android applications.

resources.title: Understand Kotlin Coroutines on Android (Google I/O'19) (Android Developers)
Understand Kotlin Coroutines on Android (Google I/O'19) (Android Developers)

topics.name: Android Studio & Build System Fundamentals
topics.description: Set up and navigate Android Studio. Understand the Android project structure, Gradle build system for project configuration, dependencies, and build variants. Learn to use the Android Debug Bridge (ADB), emulators (AVDs), and basic debugging techniques.

topics.name: Core Android Application Components
topics.description: Deep dive into the fundamental building blocks of Android applications: Activities, their lifecycle states and callbacks; explicit and implicit Intents for inter-component communication; Services for background operations; and Broadcast Receivers for system or app-wide events.

resources.title: Activities & the Activity Lifecycle - Android Basics 2023 (Philipp Lackner)
Activities & the Activity Lifecycle - Android Basics 2023 (Philipp Lackner)

topics.name: App Resources, Permissions & Manifest
topics.description: Manage various app resources including strings, drawables, layouts, styles, and themes for consistent UI. Understand the AndroidManifest.xml file for declaring components, permissions, and device compatibility. Learn about user permissions, requesting them at runtime, and securing sensitive data.

resources.title: Foster user trust by adopting privacy-respecting permission workflows (Android Developers)

project.title: Interactive Unit Converter App
project.description: Build an interactive Android application that converts between various units. Implement multiple screens, handle activity lifecycles, manage UI state, perform input validation, use different types of resources, and demonstrate basic navigation using Intents.

topics.name: XML Layouts and Traditional Views (Legacy Context)
topics.description: Master traditional Android UI development using XML layouts. Work with common View components like TextView, ImageView, Button, EditText, and ViewGroup containers such as LinearLayout, RelativeLayout, and ConstraintLayout. Implement ViewBinding for efficient view interaction and RecyclerView for displaying lists.

resources.title: Build a responsive UI with ConstraintLayout

topics.name: Jetpack Compose Fundamentals
topics.description: Master declarative UI development with Jetpack Compose. Learn the core concepts of composables, modifiers, state management (remember, mutableStateOf, derivedStateOf, produceState), recomposition, Side Effects, and built-in UI elements like Text, Button, TextField, Image, Card, Column, Row, and Box.

resources.title: Android Jetpack Compose Tutorial Introduction (Cheezy Code)

topics.name: Advanced Compose UI & Navigation
topics.description: Build complex and dynamic UIs with Jetpack Compose. Explore custom modifiers, theming (Material Design, custom themes, dark mode), basic animations, custom layouts, gesture handling, and implement navigation between screens using Jetpack Compose Navigation.

resources.title: Introduction to Navigation and Cupcake App (Android Developers)
Introduction to Material Design with Compose (Android Developers)

topics.name: Compose Previews & Basic UI Testing
topics.description: Leverage `@Preview` annotations for rapid UI iteration, design system development, and testing different device configurations. Learn the fundamentals of testing Compose UIs using `createComposeRule` and semantic matchers for robust UI verification.

resources.title: Compose Preview | Jetpack Compose Tips (Android Developers)
Write your first Compose UI test (Android Developers)

topics.name: Advanced Compose UI Patterns & Accessibility
topics.description: Explore advanced Jetpack Compose UI patterns for complex screen implementations, including handling various UI states (loading, error, empty), integrating sophisticated user input, ensuring responsive design across different screen sizes and orientations, and understanding composable lifecycle. Implement accessibility features and best practices for inclusive UI design.

resources.title: Custom layouts and graphics in Compose (Android Developers)
Build more accessible UIs with Jetpack Compose (Android Developers)

project.title: Expense Tracker UI with Compose
project.description: Develop a modern Expense Tracker application focusing on a clean Jetpack Compose UI. Implement lists of transactions, filters, basic charts for visualization, empty states, and integrate local preview data to demonstrate full UI functionality.

topics.name: App Architecture Patterns & MVVM
topics.description: Implement the MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) architecture pattern as a foundation for scalable Android apps. Understand key architectural components like ViewModel, LiveData, StateFlow, SharedFlow, and the Repository pattern. Explore principles of Clean Architecture and effective modularization to maintain clear module boundaries.

resources.title: Architecture: The UI layer - MAD Skills (Android Developers)

topics.name: Dependency Injection with Hilt
topics.description: Understand the principles of Dependency Injection (DI) and its benefits for testability, modularity, and managing dependencies. Implement DI in an Android application using Dagger Hilt, understanding annotations, modules, and component lifecycles.

resources.title: Introduction to Hilt - MAD Skills (Android Developers)

topics.name: Network Communication & RESTful APIs
topics.description: Perform network requests to consume RESTful APIs using popular libraries like Retrofit and OkHttp. Learn about JSON serialization/deserialization with Moshi or Gson. Implement robust error handling, manage network state awareness, and ensure secure handling of API keys and sensitive data.

resources.title: Consuming REST APIs in Android using Retrofit (Mitch Tabian)

topics.name: Local Data Persistence: Room & DataStore
topics.description: Persist structured data locally using the Room Persistence Library, including defining DAOs, entities, migrations, and relationships. Store key-value pairs and user preferences efficiently with DataStore. Implement strategies for offline-first experiences and data synchronization.

resources.title: Kotlin: Using Room Kotlin APIs - MAD Skills (Android Developers)
Introduction to DataStore - MAD Skills (Android Developers)

topics.name: Reliable Background Work with WorkManager
topics.description: Schedule and manage deferrable, guaranteed background tasks using WorkManager. Understand how to define constraints, differentiate between one-time and periodic work, chain tasks, and observe work status for complex background operations that need to persist system reboots.

resources.title: Mastering Android Background Tasks with WorkManager (Mindorks)

project.title: Offline-First News Reader
project.description: Build an offline-first news application that fetches articles from a public API, caches them using Room, and displays them with a Jetpack Compose UI. Implement features like saving articles, searching, and robust error recovery for network failures.

topics.name: Unit & Integration Testing
topics.description: Write comprehensive unit tests for business logic, ViewModels, and repositories using JUnit and mocking frameworks like Mockito or MockK. Develop integration tests to verify interactions between different components and ensure data flow correctness.

resources.title: Test at scale with Gradle managed devices (Android Developers)
Test at scale with Gradle managed devices (Android Developers)

topics.name: UI & Instrumentation Testing
topics.description: Implement UI tests for both traditional Android Views using Espresso and Jetpack Compose UIs using `androidx.compose.ui.test` library. Understand instrumentation testing principles, test runners, and how to verify user flows and interactions on a device or emulator.

resources.title: UI testing with Espresso - Android Testing Patterns #2 (Android Developers)
5 ways Compose improves UI testing (Android Developers)

topics.name: App Performance Optimization
topics.description: Profile and optimize app performance covering key areas: startup time, memory usage, battery consumption, and UI jank. Utilize Android Profiler tools, benchmark libraries, and apply best practices for efficient resource management, image loading, and background processing.

resources.title: Analyze app performance with Android Profiler
Making apps blazing fast with Baseline Profiles (Android Developers)
Accurately measure app performance with profileable builds (Android Developers)

topics.name: Security Best Practices
topics.description: Implement security best practices in Android apps, including secure data storage (encrypted shared preferences, Keystore), network security configuration, handling sensitive user information, preventing common vulnerabilities, and understanding ProGuard/R8 for code obfuscation and shrinking.

resources.title: FULL Guide to Encryption & Decryption in Android (Keystore, Ciphers and more) (Philipp Lackner)
Boost Android app performance with the R8 optimizer | Spotlight Week (Android Developers)

topics.name: App Release & Play Store Distribution
topics.description: Prepare Android applications for production release. Understand different build configurations (debug vs. release), sign your app bundle (AAB), and manage multiple APKs. Navigate the Google Play Console for store listings, track management (alpha/beta/production), and managing app updates.

resources.title: Upload your app to Google Play Console
Make your app shine for all devices on Google Play (Android Developers)

topics.name: Monitoring & Analytics
topics.description: Integrate analytics tools (e.g., Firebase Analytics) to track user behavior, feature usage, and engagement metrics. Set up crash reporting (e.g., Firebase Crashlytics) and performance monitoring to proactively identify and resolve issues in production environments.

resources.title: Add Firebase Crashlytics to your Android app
Address Firebase Crashlytics reports faster from Android Studio (Android Developers)
Getting started with Firebase on Android (Firebase)

project.title: Production-Ready Habit Tracker
project.description: Build, test, and prepare a polished habit tracker application for release. Implement features like local persistence, notifications, analytics-ready events, and a robust release build. Document the app's architecture and features, creating a Play Store-style listing with screenshots and privacy notes.
